payload.name: Microburbs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Microburbs is Australia's most comprehensive and accurate provider of property and geospatial data. Established in 2013, it holds over 5 billion data points covering every Australian address, street and suburb, and it is the only provider of granular street- and mesh-block-level data. Ask about any suburb or property and get answers grounded in that data: back-tested price forecasts, median prices and rents, yields and days on market, crime compared with the national median, school catchments and rankings, flood and bushfire risk, zoning and development, and census demographics. Without an account, answers cover nine sample suburbs, one in each state and territory: Bondi, Belmont North, St Kilda (Vic.), Fortitude Valley, Subiaco, Unley, Sandy Bay, Kambah and Nightcliff.

payload.name: YPulse Insights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
YPulse is a research service focused on Gen Z and Millennials (ages 13–39) — covering tweens, teens, college students, young adults, and young parents across North America and Western Europe, with over a decade of syndicated survey data.

It tracks brand perception (awareness, favorability, usage), behavioral trends (spending, social media, entertainment, finance, health, dating), and publishes editorial content/reports on youth culture. It doesn't cover Gen X, Boomers, or anyone over 40.

payload.name: Vibewatch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Give ChatGPT access to your community's vibe. Vibewatch is community intelligence for web3 teams: it reads your community across Discord, Telegram, X, and more, scores the vibe, surfaces daily insights, and writes weekly reports. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your Vibewatch organization through the hosted Vibewatch MCP server — sentiment overview, daily trend, message search, daily insights, weekly reports, market context, and the public Stacks ecosystem index, all read-only. Sign in with your Vibewatch account.

payload.name: Plota: Planning Applications
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plota brings UK planning applications and planning permission records into ChatGPT. Ask about any address, postcode, street or council in England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland and get the applications themselves: the proposal, status and decision, key dates, and a link to the official council record.

What you can ask:

- What has been applied for at or near an address, and what is pending next door
- Everything about one site in a single answer: its applications, related amendments and appeals, larger -housing schemes nearby, and planning constraints such as flood zones, conservation areas, listed buildings and green belt
- How long a council takes to decide planning applications, and how often it approves them
- Planning appeals and their outcomes, and planning permissions that are about to lapse
- New applications by type, size or number of homes, across a town, a council or the whole country

Used by homeowners checking what is planned nearby, and by architects, planning consultants, developers, property professionals and suppliers tracking new work. Records are collected daily from council planning registers, and every answer links back to its source.

Sign in with your Plota account, or enter your email to start on the free demo allowance. Some features, such as site constraints, depend on your Plota plan.

payload.name: Personyze
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Personyze is a web personalization and A/B testing platform. This app lets ChatGPT work with your Personyze account directly: read how campaigns are performing, inspect and draft personalization actions, search and update visitor profiles, and manage audiences — in conversation, without writing code or opening the panel.

Typical uses: "which campaigns lost conversion rate last week", "add everyone who viewed the pricing page to the Enterprise Prospects audience", "draft a banner for returning visitors from paid search", "what did this visitor do before they converted".

Read and write are both supported; every action runs under the permissions of the account that authorized the connection, and access is revoked by deleting the API key in Personyze under Integrations.

payload.name: ラッコキーワード
payload.description: キーワード/競合分析ツール（SEO・マーケティング調査）
payload.summaryOriginal: キーワード/競合分析ツール（SEO・マーケティング調査）
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ラッコキーワード（RakkoKeyword）は、日本最大級のキーワードリサーチツールです。このプラグインを使うと、ChatGPTとの会話から直接キーワードリサーチとSEO分析を実行できます。

できること:
・Google・Bing・YouTube・Amazon・楽天などのサジェストキーワード取得
・独自データベースからの関連キーワード・よくある質問の取得
・LSIキーワード、他の人はこちらも質問（PAA）、同時ランクインキーワードといった関連トピックの探索
・月間検索数・SEO難易度・CPC・競合性の取得（月別推移つき）
・Google検索順位の実測
・競合分析: 任意のドメインが獲得しているキーワードと主力集客ページの抽出
・指定キーワードで検索流入を集めているページ・サイトの検索
・SEOライティング支援: 検索上位ページの見出し・共起語の抽出

活用例:
・SEO記事の構成案・タイトル・見出しの設計
・コンテンツ企画・ネタ出し、市場・需要調査
・競合サイトの自然検索の流入キーワード分析
・EC（Amazon・楽天）の商品リサーチ

日本の検索市場データに強みがあり、月間検索数の調査では海外の地域・言語の指定にも対応しています。利用にはラッコキーワードのアカウントが必要です。

payload.name: Seal Copilot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Seal Copilot turns your Sealmetrics data into decisions: a verdict first, the evidence with numbers, one action, and a date to check it.

It diagnoses drops down to the campaign that caused them, finds revenue left on the table, audits catalog friction per product, watches the cart during the day against a learned baseline, and reviews your tracking setup. Fourteen procedures over one methodology, with playbooks for ecommerce, hotels and SaaS that it picks from your own tracking.

Every figure comes from a tool result in the same session: it never invents a number, and it refuses to conclude when the sample is too small. Requires a Sealmetrics account.

payload.name: Fospha (EMEA & APAC)
payload.description: Ask, answer, act on your data.
payload.summaryOriginal: Ask, answer, act on your data.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Fospha's daily, validated, cross-channel measurement to ChatGPT and get instant answers on your paid marketing performance - what's working, where you have room to scale, and what to do next. In the tools and language your team already works in, so every insight becomes action before it decays.

payload.name: Leadstore.xyz
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Leadstore tracks how your brand shows up in AI search — ChatGPT, Google, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Grok — and helps you act on what it finds.

Connect your Leadstore account and ask for things that would otherwise take several dashboards: your AI visibility score and the prompts you are cited in, share of voice against tracked competitors, keyword and content gaps, technical audit findings, and where your brand is being discussed on other sites.

You can also work on content in the conversation. Read a blog draft together with its quality report and the plan it was written from, edit the parts that need work, and watch the score update — then schedule or publish it to a connected CMS such as WordPress, Sanity or Framer.

The plugin acts as you, using your own Leadstore login through a standard OAuth sign-in, and you can revoke access at any time. A Leadstore account is required.

payload.name: Laup
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Laup tracks how ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot and Claude answer the buying questions your customers ask, and whether they recommend your business or a competitor. This plugin brings that data into ChatGPT so you can explore it in conversation.

Ask for your AI visibility per engine and product category, read the exact answers for a prompt, see which websites the engines used as sources, and review the web searches they ran. You can also check your site's AI readiness and work through your Laup action plan: evaluate and verify recommendations, triage them and add comments.

Requires a Laup account with at least one tracked domain.

payload.name: Versive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Versive lets you run AI-moderated user research from ChatGPT. Create studies that combine fixed survey questions (multiple choice, ratings, NPS, ranking) with adaptive AI-interview questions, organize them with question groups and branching logic, and share a link that participants take as a conversational interview. As responses come in, check completion and drop-off stats, per-question aggregates, and individual interview transcripts, or export everything as CSV — without leaving the chat.

payload.name: Momently
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Momently is the data platform for modern publishers. It connects social, web, newsletter, and ad platforms in one place and turns them into live dashboards, branded campaign reports, and benchmarks. This plugin gives Momently customers a direct line to that data from ChatGPT.

Ask questions in plain language and get real answers from your own workspace: how campaigns are performing, which platform drove the most impressions, how delivery is pacing against goals, which posts performed best this quarter, or how campaigns for a prospect's category usually perform based on your own history. Results come back with links into Momently, shareable branded PDF reports, and the actual creatives with thumbnails.

Everything is read-only and permission-aware. Each person signs in with their own Momently account, sees only the workspaces they already belong to, and every request is checked against their permissions on every call. The plugin cannot change anything in Momently.

Built for publisher teams: sales pulling benchmarks before a pitch, client services checking pacing and prepping wrap reports, editorial and social teams reviewing content performance, and leadership asking for the quarter in one question.

Requires a Momently workspace with the connector enabled. Visit momently.com/connector for setup guides.

payload.name: 中央社新聞 CNA TAIWAN NEWS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CNA provides a trusted, source-based news search and research service that allows users to search Central News Agency reporting directly within ChatGPT, stay informed about recent developments, and organize the evolving context surrounding specific people, events, and public issues.

Using natural language, users can search CNA news reports as well as content from CNA almanac, special features, and multilingual news coverage in English, Japanese, Indonesian, and other languages. The service also supports searches for standardized translations of foreign names and proper nouns, news photographs, government information, and fact-checking materials, helping users compare information across multiple sources and clarify uncertain claims. It can also organize retrieved information into event timelines, concise topic briefs, newspaper-style layouts, and relationship maps of people and organizations. These capabilities are suitable for news research, event retrospectives, issue tracking, information verification, content planning, and background research.

Responses preserve news headlines, publication dates, source information, and links to original articles whenever possible, allowing users to review the original reporting and conduct further verification. Some search results may come from government agencies, fact-checking organizations, contributed content, or other image sources; the system identifies their origins where available. The use and licensing of images remain subject to the terms, copyright requirements, and other applicable rules of their original sources.

payload.name: TitanSigma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TitanSigma unifies all your data and sends it to your BI tool, simplifying how you track KPIs and metrics.
No more digging through spreadsheets or chasing down reports.
Just clear numbers your team can use to run the business better.

payload.name: HFS Research
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring HFS Research’s library of knowledge and research into your AI assistant. This connector gives authenticated HFS Research members conversational access to HFS’ published content. This content includes research reports, blogs, podcasts, videocasts, and quick takes. Ask questions and get cited answers drawn straight from HFS analysis.
What you can do: search across everything (semantic search returns the most relevant passages with source report, author, date, and link); filter by type (research, blogs, podcasts, videocasts, or quick takes); browse the latest; find by topic or author; and open a specific item by reference.
It is read-only. The MCP connector retrieves and cites HFS content and never posts, edits, or deletes anything. Access requires an eligible HFS Research membership; you sign in with your HFS account, and results reflect your entitlement. Every answer links back to the HFS Research site so you can read the full report.

payload.name: Flippo AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Flippo keeps a reseller's inventory, purchases and sales in one place.

Ask what is still unsold, what a purchase returned, or how much profit a
month brought in, and the answer comes from your own records.

You can look up items, see what has been sitting too long, compare margins
across platforms, and record a sale as it happens.

Requires a Flippo account.

payload.name: Advan Research REI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn foot traffic and demographic data into actionable real estate insights. Analyze property performance, compare locations and competitors, understand trade areas and customer profiles, evaluate tenant opportunities, and identify strong sites for retail brands. Built for brokers, landlords, and site selectors who want data-backed answers for leasing, acquisition, renewal, and location decisions.

payload.name: Adzviser CallTrackingMetrics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your CTM data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to see how many calls and texts your marketing is generating and which channels are driving them.

Compare total calls, answered and missed calls, call duration, and conversions across date ranges. Break results down by tracking number, source, campaign, or agent. Turn your call tracking data into clear reports and see which channels are actually producing conversations.

payload.name: Index Energia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore data and information about Brazil’s electric power sector with Index Energia. Access prices, market data, system operations, generation, load, hydrology, reservoirs, curtailment, CCEE data, regulatory documents, Brazilian Official Gazette publications, and structured analyses in one place.

payload.name: Inspectform
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Inspectform helps insurance professionals collect property data to populate applications and Statements of Values (SOVs). Connect your Inspectform account to search U.S. addresses and surface decades of hard-to-find property updates, including available permit histories for roofs, HVAC, plumbing, and electrical systems, with source-linked COPE findings.

Coverage and freshness vary by property and source. Searches use your organization’s existing credits and require approved access.

New to Inspectform? Request access at https://inspectform.io/mcp/access.

payload.name: HOT AI搜車
payload.description: 搜尋與比較公開在售中古車
payload.summaryOriginal: 搜尋與比較公開在售中古車
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HOT AI搜車協助使用者依品牌、車款、預算、年份、里程、車身型式、燃料種類、座位數、保固條件及車商所在地，搜尋並比較目前公開在售的中古車。搜尋結果來自HOT大聯盟的第一方公開庫存；此工具不提供中古車估價、市場行情判定、預約、交易或聯絡車商功能。

payload.name: forms.app: Form Builder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create any online form right in ChatGPT for free and collect unlimited responses.

With forms.app MCP, you can let ChatGPT manage your forms, fetch the responses, get statistics, and do so much more. Whether it’s RSVP forms, research surveys, registration forms, or any other forms, forms.app fits right into your AI workflows.

Example uses:

- Creating forms from a description: "Create an onboarding survey for a branding agency with necessary contact details, brand personality questions, and questions about must-haves"

- Evaluating a form’s performance: "Take a look at my job application form’s content, drop-off rates, and statistics; then tell me about how my form performs, as well as pointers on how to improve its conversions"

- Analyzing submissions: Based on the responses we got from our employee survey, what should be our priority to improve morale and collaboration?

- Visualizing form data: "Get the statistics and drop-off rates of my feedback form; analyze them and create compelling visuals I can use in a presentation"

payload.name: social.plus Agentry
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
social.plus Agentry connects ChatGPT to the first-party data your app already generates. Ask questions about your community, users, content, activity, and growth in plain language, and get a clear answer ready to visualize, tabulate or dig into with follow-up questions.

Ask things like:
- I'm prepping a campaign brief. What content formats drove the most activity last month, and which user segments engaged the most?
- We launched a new feature last Tuesday. How did user activity change in the days after compared to the week before?
- I have a QBR in an hour. Give me a snapshot of growth, active users, and top-performing content in this quarter.
- What are the trending topics this week? Any notable shifts in what users are talking about?
- Break down our most active user segments by how they engage. Who posts, who comments, who reacts?

Your data stays yours: Agentry is read-only. It never posts, modifies, or deletes anything. Data refreshes daily and covers roughly the last 90 days of activity.

To connect, you'll need a social.plus network with Agentry enabled and a connect code from a Console super admin.

payload.name: BigQuery
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Query and manage BigQuery datasets, tables, jobs, and routines.

payload.name: Coupler.io
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyze multi-channel marketing, financial, sales, e-commerce, and other business data within ChatGPT by connecting to your Coupler.io data flows – query marketing, sales, and finance metrics from hundreds of sources. Fetch and transform raw data from hundreds of platforms like Google Ads, Meta Ads, HubSpot, and QuickBooks into actionable intelligence for smarter, faster decision-making with accurate, up-to-date business information.

payload.name: Coupler.io
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyze data from 400+ apps

payload.name: Sometrend
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover hidden trends with ease.

You don’t need data analysis experience to get started. Sometrend is your AI-powered social data partner, helping anyone quickly uncover meaningful insights and understand public reactions behind emerging trends.

Simply ask in your own words, like “Analyze the latest zero-sugar beverage trend,” and Sometrend will analyze vast amounts of social data to reveal the context and meaning behind the trend.

Turn trends into opportunities in ChatGPT and create new success.

This service does not perform analysis for the purpose of identifying individuals; it focuses on statistical and contextual analysis of social content. Excerpts from original posts or external links may be provided to aid understanding of the analysis results, but these are offered solely as internal references for analysis.

payload.name: Sometrend
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover hidden trends with ease.

You don’t need data analysis experience to get started. Sometrend is your AI-powered social data partner, helping anyone quickly uncover meaningful insights and understand public reactions behind emerging trends.

Simply ask in your own words, like “Analyze the latest zero-sugar beverage trend,” and Sometrend will analyze vast amounts of social data to reveal the context and meaning behind the trend.

Turn trends into opportunities in ChatGPT and create new success.

This service does not perform analysis for the purpose of identifying individuals; it focuses on statistical and contextual analysis of social content. Excerpts from original posts or external links may be provided to aid understanding of the analysis results, but these are offered solely as internal references for analysis.

payload.name: Everest Group AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Everest Group AI brings Everest Group research and insights directly into ChatGPT, enabling users to access and consume research without leaving their ChatGPT workflow.

Using natural language, users can ask questions about topics important to their work and receive relevant answers grounded in Everest Group content.

For example, users can ask questions such as “What is the market growth in healthcare CXM intelligent operations?” and “What factors are becoming most important in shaping offshore location strategies?” and receive complete responses synthesized through Everest Group's breadth of research.

Access to the agent requires an active Everest Group membership. Users will be prompted to authenticate using their Everest Group website credentials before accessing Everest Group research through the agent. The agent’s responses will include cited content, access to which will depend on the user’s membership. To learn about Everest Group membership, visit www.everestgrp.com/contact-us.

AI Disclaimer: Responses are AI-generated using Everest Group content and may contain inaccuracies. Users should refer to the cited Everest Group research and source materials when additional verification is required. Please report any inappropriate content to privacy@everestgrp.com.

payload.name: Pillr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pillr gives free, no-login access to French real estate public data: the price per square meter for any municipality, a market summary (rent, yield, price trends, zoning), and the permit or declaration requirements for a renovation project. Every figure is sourced from official public data (DVF, DHUP, INSEE) and French urbanism law, with no listings, no addresses, and no proprietary scoring shown.

payload.name: Statiko
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Statiko brings public Telegram channel data into ChatGPT, so you can research what's happening on Telegram without leaving the conversation.

Ask what's trending across tracked channels in the last 24 hours, then read the actual posts behind a story to see what it's about. Look up any tracked channel for its profile, subscriber count and growth, posting frequency, view rate and engagement - or compare up to ten channels side by side in a single answer. Find channels similar to one you already follow, search a  channel's own posts by keyword or date range, and trace how a specific post's views, forwards and reactions built up hour by hour.

Every answer links back to the source page on statiko.io, so you can check the numbers yourself.

Statiko is read-only: it looks up public channel data and never posts, joins or messages on your behalf. Connecting requires a Statiko account on the Pro or Business plan.

payload.name: The Viral Sauce
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your The Viral Sauce account to discuss your Instagram performance in ChatGPT. Explore stored account and Reel measurements, review your published TVS findings, and turn your existing recommendations into a practical publishing plan. Choose which Instagram accounts to share and disconnect at any time. Available data depends on your TVS subscription.

payload.name: SignalCrow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore cell sites, mobile operators, signal measurements and speed-test summaries for an area with SignalCrow. Compare available network observations and inspect individual sites to better understand local mobile connectivity.

Requires a verified SignalCrow account. Available data and usage limits depend on your account. Measurements reflect available observations and do not guarantee coverage, indoor reception or future speeds.

payload.name: ActivityInfo.org
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read and analyse data in ActivityInfo databases. Lists databases, forms and fields, retrieves records, and runs pivot analyses.

payload.name: Nova42
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Nova42 gives authorized retail teams a read-only conversational view of their latest published workspace data. Track performance, prepare retailer meetings, prioritize current issues, analyze confirmed price evidence, and verify distribution coverage. Every result remains limited to the signed-in user's authorized workspaces, reports publication freshness, and distinguishes observed values, explicit zeroes, null values, absent data, and data not yet observed.

payload.name: Marketing Intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search a curated library of proven ads, emails, campaigns, and growth playbooks. Compare examples by brand, channel, topic, and marketing objective, then retrieve focused text previews for research and planning.

payload.name: TuneWorks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TuneWorks connects ChatGPT to your performance vehicle workspace, giving you access to the build history, setup data, sessions, maintenance, ECU logs, and other information behind each vehicle.

Analyze performance data, compare setup revisions, review driving sessions, diagnose problems, track maintenance, manage shop and event preparation, and use the history of a build to understand what changed and decide what to test next. TuneWorks keeps logs, setups, sessions, charts, notes, and vehicle information connected so decisions are based on the full context of the build.

TuneWorks supports both read and write actions, allowing you to retrieve information and take action directly from ChatGPT. You can also collaborate around shared vehicles and builds, maintain an ongoing performance history, and share selected build information with tuners, teammates, shops, or crew.

payload.name: Converly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Converly is the easiest way to send conversions to Google Ads, Meta Ads, ChatGPT Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4, and more when someone submits a form, schedules an appointment or starts a chat on your site.

This plugin makes it super easy to set up. You simply say things like 'Send conversions to ChatGPT Ads when someone submits the contact form on my website' and the plugin will set up a conversion flow, give you a snippet of code to add to your site, and test that it's all set up and working.

It can detect conversions in 100+ tools, including Gravity Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Typeform, Jotform, Webflow Forms, Wix Forms, Squarespace Forms, Calendly, Acuity Scheduling, Cal.com & more.

It can send conversions to 20+ destinations, including Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Ads, ChatGPT Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads and more.

Converly supports conditional logic so you can decide exactly when a conversion fires, such as when someone submits your Quote Request form but not your Contact Support form.

Instead of relying on the visitor's browser to send conversions, Converly sends conversions directly to the ad platforms' servers, where ad blockers and privacy restrictions in iOS and Safari can't get in the way.

It also captures the lead's name, email, phone, click IDs, IP address, device, etc and sends it with the conversion. This gives ad platforms the data they need to match the conversion back to a real person and the original ad they clicked. Ultimately, this means you get more accurate conversion data, and your ad platform can understand what a good lead looks like for your business so it can go find more of them.

Converly gives you a full debug log that shows exactly what was captured, what was sent where, and whether it arrived successfully. You can even query it through the plugin by saying something like 'Is my conversion tracking working properly' and it will query the log and respond.

payload.name: Epinium
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask about your Amazon business and get the answer from your own data, without exporting a spreadsheet.

Epinium reads your catalog, your advertising and your automations:

• Catalog — one product entity that merges the Seller Central, Vendor Central and Advertising views of the same ASIN, with brands, barcodes and keyword clusters.

• Advertising — campaigns, ad groups, targets and product ads across Sponsored Products, Brands and Display, with budgets and bidding strategies.

• Performance — spend, sales, ACOS, ROAS, clicks and impressions per campaign, ad group, target, product ad and shopper search term. Seller Central sessions, Buy Box share, conversion rate and Best Seller Rank. Vendor Central manufacturing and sourcing figures reported separately, the way the two models actually work.

• Automations — what each workflow is set up to do, which campaigns it processes, and how those campaigns performed since it started optimizing them.

Typical questions: which campaigns had the worst ACOS last month, which search terms are burning budget without producing orders, which products get traffic but do not convert, what a workflow has actually been doing.

Results come back as an interactive table you can sort and drill into.

The plugin only reads. It never changes a bid, a budget or a listing. Requires an Epinium account with at least one Amazon connection.

payload.name: Cubi Estate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cubi Estate is an AI-native property search engine for Europe. The plugin gives ChatGPT read-only access to a continuously updated corpus of over one million active sale and rental listings across Europe — Portugal, Spain, Italy, France, Germany and more — searchable in 7 languages. Tools cover natural-language search ("2-bed apartment in Porto under €400k with a balcony"), structured filtering, full listing details with source links, and day-by-day market statistics (new listings, deactivations, price drops, per country). Every result links back to its original source listing. All tools are read-only and annotated as such; nothing mutates data, and no user accounts are required.

payload.name: Mavvrik
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Mavvrik connects ChatGPT to your Mavvrik tenant so you can ask cloud cost questions and get answers from your actual data – no dashboard required. Ask about spend trends, cost drivers, budget variances, anomalies, and savings recommendations in plain language. Built for FinOps practitioners, cloud engineers, and anyone who needs fast cost intelligence without manually filtering reports. Current coverage includes Cloud Cost, Cost Variances, Recommendations, and Anomalies across your connected cloud accounts.

payload.name: Outlook Email
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Microsoft Outlook email for work conversations: search messages, summarize threads, draft replies, manage follow-ups.
payload.longDescription: 用于工作沟通的 Microsoft Outlook 邮件：搜索邮件、总结对话串、起草回复并管理后续跟进。

payload.name: Slack
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Look up chats and messages

payload.name: Superhuman Mail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Superhuman Mail to build powerful workflows across Gmail, Outlook, and Google Calendar. Search your inbox and calendar, summarize what matters, draft AI replies in your voice, check read statuses, prepare for your day, send emails or schedule events, and manage multiple Gmail and Outlook accounts.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Superhuman Mail，在 Gmail、Outlook 和 Google Calendar 之间构建强大的工作流程。搜索收件箱和日历、总结重要内容、以你的口吻拟写 AI 回复、查看已读状态、为一天的安排做准备、发送邮件或安排活动，并管理多个 Gmail 和 Outlook 账户。

payload.name: Gmail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use Gmail to summarize inbox activity, draft replies, and organize email threads through the connected Gmail app.
payload.longDescription: 通过已连接的 Gmail 应用，使用 Gmail 总结收件箱活动、拟写回复并整理邮件会话。

payload.name: Teams
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Microsoft Teams workplace chat and collaboration: search messages, summarize threads, send replies, manage Planner tasks.

payload.name: Hostinger Mail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hostinger Mail helps users discover mailbox operations, inspect mailboxes and folders, read or search messages, send email, and manage message or webhook state in their authenticated Hostinger Mail account through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Zoom
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zoom connects Codex to Zoom meeting context through the Zoom app connector and provides developer workflows for planning, building, debugging, and reviewing Zoom integrations across APIs, SDKs, webhooks, WebSockets, bots, and automation use cases.

payload.name: Mailopoly Inbox
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mailopoly brings supported email accounts and messaging services into one unified inbox. Connect Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook, Microsoft 365, iCloud Mail, Yahoo Mail, or a compatible IMAP mailbox. Search across connected accounts, read complete emails and attachment text, catch up on new mail, and draft or send email from a connected account.

Mailopoly analyzes connected email to surface priorities and extract tasks, meetings and events, invoices and bills with amounts and due dates, and parcel deliveries. Organize messages with smart lists, troubleshoot syncing and reconnection, and receive an optional daily briefing.

Mailopoly also supports authorized connections to Slack, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp, TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram. Messages from connected services appear alongside email, can be searched in the same inbox, and can be answered in their original service.

A Mailopoly account is required.

payload.name: Brevo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Brevo to analyze email campaign performance and A/B test results, look up contacts, and explore audience segments in plain language, all without leaving your conversation. ChatGPT can also generate HTML email templates, draft email campaigns, and draft SMS campaigns, saved directly to your Brevo account for you to review before sending. ChatGPT will never send or schedule email campaigns, and will never delete anything on your behalf. Available on all Brevo plans.

payload.name: Rhythm AI Personality Tuner
payload.description: Tune how ChatGPT talks to you
payload.summaryOriginal: Tune how ChatGPT talks to you
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Everyone has a Rhythm — a way they like to be talked to.

Rhythm AI Personality Tuner lets you shape ChatGPT's voice to match yours. Five quick cards, fifteen sliders, about a minute: choose how warm or professional it should feel, how direct, how much detail, whether it should challenge your thinking or validate first, hold you accountable or keep things gentle. When you finish, ChatGPT starts speaking your rhythm right there in the conversation — and a before-and-after preview shows you the difference.

Prefer it straight? Your rhythm can say so. Turn down the praise, turn up the pushback, and get answers that tell you what you need to hear — not just what you want to hear.

Your rhythm tunes fifteen dimensions of how ChatGPT communicates, including the ones that matter when a conversation gets personal: emotional awareness, encouragement, and the kind of support you actually want in the moment.

Save your rhythm with a free Rhythm account to keep it. It follows you into new conversations — just @-mention Rhythm to bring it along — and into the Rhythm app, a space to reflect, process, and grow at your own pace. Tune it in either place; it stays in sync.

payload.name: AI Roleplay Chat Simulator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Talk to anyone, anytime, without the pressure.

This app lets you role play conversations with smart AI people so you can practice before real life.

Pick who you want to talk to, choose a situation, and start chatting. Practice a job interview, a first date, a hard talk with a friend, a meeting with your boss, small talk, customer service, school, travel, or almost any other conversation. The AI answers like a real person and keeps the conversation going. You can try again, change your words, and build confidence one chat at a time.

Talking to people is not always easy. Sometimes you do not know what to say. Sometimes you want to practice before an important moment. This app gives you a safe place to learn. There is no need to feel rushed. You can stop, start again, or try a different answer whenever you want. Every conversation is a chance to learn something new.

Choose from many different people and situations. Talk to a friendly coworker, a teacher, a customer, a neighbor, a family member, a hiring manager, a classmate, a travel guide, a doctor, or create your own character. You can make conversations easy, medium, or hard. You decide how the other person acts. They can be kind, serious, funny, shy, calm, excited, or challenging. Every chat feels fresh because the AI responds to what you say.

Practice for real life in a simple way. Get ready for interviews by answering common questions. Rehearse speeches and presentations. Learn how to ask for help. Practice saying no in a kind way. Prepare for school, work, meetings, travel, shopping, or everyday conversations. Try difficult talks before they happen so you feel more ready when the real moment comes.

Learning is easier when you can practice again and again. If you do not like your answer, try another one. See how different words can change the conversation. Explore different paths and discover new ways to communicate. Every practice session helps you become more comfortable speaking with other people.

The app is great for students, professionals, language learners, job seekers, teachers, parents, travelers, and anyone who wants to become a better communicator. Whether you are preparing for something important or simply want to improve your everyday conversation skills, there is always something new to practice.

You can create your own role play ideas too. Type in a situation, describe the person you want to talk with, and let the AI build a conversation just for you. Make fun stories, serious talks, fantasy adventures, business meetings, classroom lessons, or everyday life scenes. The possibilities are almost endless.

The AI listens to what you say and answers naturally. Each conversation changes based on your choices, making every session feel unique. Explore different ideas, ask questions, solve problems together, or simply enjoy a friendly chat. The more you practice, the more comfortable speaking can become.

Simple to use and easy to enjoy, this app is made for anyone who wants to practice conversations in a safe and private space. Open the app, choose a person, start talking, and learn by doing. Build confidence, improve communication, explore new situations, and get ready for real conversations one message at a time. Whether your goal is better social skills, stronger communication, interview success, language practice, or everyday confidence, this app helps you practice, learn, and grow through natural AI role play conversations whenever you are ready.

payload.name: Prezi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Prezi's plugin takes slides you already have, made in ChatGPT, generated in another tool, or uploaded as a PowerPoint or PDF, and places them on Prezi's open, zoomable canvas, turning a flat deck into a highly visual, interactive presentation. You get a full suite of presentation, engagement, and sharing tools that go beyond static slides: engagement features like polls, quizzes, and Q&A help you teach, sell, and give your ideas traction long after the slides are made.

Already have a deck? Bring it in. Or describe a topic and Prezi will build one for you, with an inline animated preview as it renders. Revise in place: add, edit, reorder, or remove slides and switch themes.

Present and share your way:
Present live with your content next to you in an interactive video with Newscaster mode
Share and export it as a narrated video or a podcast
Share one interactive link where your audience can answer polls and quizzes, submit and upvote questions, and respond to word clouds live or on their own time
Export to PDF, PowerPoint, or SCORM

Every deck lands in your own Prezi account. New decks are private on paid plans and public on free plans. A public deck can be opened by anyone with its link; a private deck has no share link. Changing a deck's visibility requires a paid plan. Signing in with your Prezi account is required.

Sample prompts:
@Prezi create an interactive lesson about [topic] for [audience]. Include an opening poll, a visual explanation, a demonstration, two knowledge checks, a word cloud, and a final quiz.
@Prezi turn the attached presentation into a zoomable, interactive presentation for [audience]. Create a clear presentation path and add an opening poll, a word cloud after [section], a moderated Q&A, a five-question quiz, and a feedback activity.
@Prezi review this presentation and add audience activities in the most useful places. Include an opening poll, a midpoint word cloud, a moderated Q&A, a five-question closing quiz, and a feedback form.

payload.name: RingCentral Phone
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RingCentral Phone helps you manage your personal RingCentral communications directly from ChatGPT. Catch up on missed calls, search SMS conversations, review voicemail and message details, check call recordings or AI notes, look up contacts, and see user presence without jumping between tools. It is designed for individual users who want a faster way to stay on top of day-to-day communications. Ask natural questions like “Who called me yesterday?”, “Find my texts with Alex,” or “Do I have any unread voicemails?” and RingCentral Phone can retrieve the relevant information from your RingCentral account. When you are ready to follow up, it can also help send SMS messages through RingCentral. RingCentral Phone is focused on personal communication workflows, not account administration, provisioning, or team-wide system management. This beta is an early step toward bringing RingCentral communications into the AI tools people use every day, and the experience will continue to improve with feedback.

payload.name: Inkbox
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Inkbox gives an AI assistant its own communication identity: an email address, a phone number, SMS and iMessage, and voice calls, reachable by humans and other agents alike. The assistant reads and sends from its own inbox, handles its own calls and texts, and keeps a contact book and notes that carry context between conversations. Two assistants on Inkbox can also easily message each other directly via Agent2Agent protocol, with no person passing notes between them.

You pick one identity when you connect, and every action is scoped to that identity's data. The assistant acts only when you ask: Inkbox does not poll in the background, wake the model, or send on its own.

Phone numbers are currently available in the United States. Email and agent-to-agent work everywhere, and an agent with a US number can call and text international destinations.

payload.name: Orbismo
payload.description: Build a world your AI knows
payload.summaryOriginal: Build a world your AI knows
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Keep track of the people, places, events, and details that make up your world. Any AI you use can draw on it in any chat, so you never have to start over, whether you build solo or bring in your whole team. Orbismo keeps it all connected in a world you own, customize, and share.

payload.name: Send Postcard
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Send Postcard lets you design a physical postcard and send it anywhere in the world, all from within a conversation. Open the built-in editor to compose your message and choose your image, then place an order through a secure Stripe checkout. Once payment is confirmed, the order goes straight to a print-and-mail partner who handles printing, addressing, and delivery. You get a live status update at each stage: pending, shipped, refunded, or expired. People love it for birthday greetings, travel notes, thank-you cards, and staying in touch with family without leaving the chat. This app does not cover digital greeting cards, email campaigns, gift wrapping, merchandise printing, poster or canvas orders, package shipping, or any intent beyond designing and mailing a standard physical postcard.

payload.name: TIM Brasil
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Compare planos e encontre o melhor pra você

payload.name: Turnfeed
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turnfeed is a public social feed inside ChatGPT. See recent posts, open full conversations, and find people without signing in. Connect your Turnfeed identity to post, reply, like, follow, update your profile, and use safety controls. Before anything changes, ChatGPT shows the action for approval.

payload.name: Kepler
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kepler gives ChatGPT secure access to the personal and team knowledge you have saved across the web — links, pages, videos, images, notes, annotations, and references.

Instead of re-explaining your research in every conversation, ChatGPT can search your Kepler Spaces and retrieve the right context at the right time. Kepler extracts memory not only from page text, but also from rich content such as videos and images, so results include useful context rather than just a URL and title.

Organize saved knowledge into personal or shared Spaces, collaborate with teammates through annotations and notes, and let ChatGPT draw on that collective knowledge whenever you need it.

payload.name: AT&T
payload.description: 选购互联网与无线通信服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AT&T Products provides an integrated conversational experience that enables users to verify home internet availability, evaluate internet and wireless offerings, explore devices and service plans, locate AT&T stores, manage shopping carts, and transition seamlessly to AT&T checkout.
payload.longDescription: AT&T Products 提供一体化对话体验，支持用户查询家庭互联网服务是否覆盖其地址、比较互联网和无线通信服务、了解设备及服务套餐、查找 AT&T 门店、管理购物车，并顺畅进入 AT&T 结账流程。

payload.name: Textmagic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Textmagic brings business SMS into your AI assistant. Send and schedule text messages, preview cost and recipients before sending, track delivery, and read incoming replies without leaving the chat. Manage your address book too: search contacts, create and update them, organize lists and tags. Every send is previewed and confirmed before it goes out, and messaging always respects your account balance and permissions. Ideal for appointment reminders, alerts, follow-ups and quick customer replies.

payload.name: Fyxer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fyxer for ChatGPT lets you write emails that sound like you, right from the chat. Fyxer learns your writing style from past emails and uses context from your calendar and meeting notes to create personalized email drafts. Just describe what you want to say and get a polished email ready to review and send.

payload.name: NoPressure
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
NoPressure is a communication-skills practice for the workplace. It turns a hard conversation into a live voice roleplay you can rehearse before the real one: delivering critical feedback, saying no to a request, handling a performance review, pushing back on a stakeholder, negotiating a raise, running a first 1:1 with a new team.

Describe the situation once — who the other person is, where they stand, and what makes it hard. ChatGPT can assemble that brief from what is already in the conversation, including anything you have brought in from the other tools you use, so the character is built on the real people and the real stakes instead of a generic template. NoPressure sees only the brief it is handed: it has no access to your calendar, mail, or documents. From that brief, it generates the character, a scene image, and a voice, then shows a start card in the chat. Pressing Start opens the voice call in the NoPressure web app, where you speak out loud with someone who holds their own position and pushes back.

When the session ends, the debrief comes back to the card: the key insight, how you handled the core challenge, and where to focus next. Send it into the chat, with the transcript of what was said, and work through it with ChatGPT. Simulations are reusable, so you can run one again and compare the attempt against an earlier try, or edit its title, card description, and character first. Each one lives in your own private NoPressure workspace.

payload.name: RingCentral Chat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RingCentral Chat helps you manage your RingCentral Team Chat collaboration directly from ChatGPT. Catch up on recent conversations, read posts and shared files, review notes, tasks, and events, find coworkers, and inspect teams without jumping between tools. It is designed for RingCentral users who want a faster way to stay informed and collaborate with their teams. Ask natural questions like “What did I miss in the launch chat?”, “Show my incomplete tasks,” or “Find the file Alex shared,” and RingCentral Chat can retrieve the relevant information from your RingCentral account. When you are ready to take action, it can also help send or update posts, create tasks and Adaptive Cards, manage teams, and configure incoming webhooks. RingCentral Chat is focused on Team Chat collaboration, not SMS, phone calls, voicemail, email, account administration, or user provisioning. This beta is an early step toward bringing RingCentral collaboration into the AI tools people use every day, and the experience will continue to improve with feedback.

payload.name: Breakreach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Breakreach connects your social media accounts to ChatGPT. Create, schedule and publish posts across 12 platforms (X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Threads, LinkedIn, YouTube,
Pinterest, Bluesky, Reddit, Telegram, Discord) directly from a conversation. The plugin
finds your next free posting slot, uploads media from URLs, and returns unified analytics
(views, likes, comments, shares) for your published posts. Requires a Breakreach account
with connected social accounts.

payload.name: Klaxoon
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Klaxoon MCP helps users read, summarize, organize, and update Klaxoon whiteboards, helping teams prepare workshops, structure ideas, and turn board content into actionable outputs through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Publora
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Publora lets ChatGPT publish and schedule your social media posts across ten networks: LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Bluesky, Mastodon and Telegram.

Connect your accounts once, then work in plain language. Ask for a post to be drafted and kept as a draft for you to approve, attach an image or video, schedule it for a specific time, or check what is already queued. Publora handles each network's own rules, so you don't have to think about character limits, media requirements or threading.

On LinkedIn it can also comment, react and reshare from the same conversation.

You need a Publora account with at least one connected social account. The free plan works.

payload.name: Speko
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Speko gives ChatGPT a phone line. Describe the call you want — confirm an appointment, chase a quote, ask a clinic which insurance it takes — and Speko dials the number with a voice agent, stays on the line, and hands back a full transcript and a recording when it ends. Every call opens by saying it is an AI. Before dialing a real person you can rehearse the whole conversation against a synthetic caller and read that transcript first. Speko also transcribes audio from a link, including its own call recordings, and speaks text back in hundreds of voices and languages ChatGPT cannot produce itself.

payload.name: Geekbot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Run async standups, team updates, check-ins, polls, surveys, and get progress summaries in Slack and Microsoft Teams.

Geekbot is an assistant for Slack and Microsoft Teams that helps remote and hybrid teams automate standups, daily updates, team check-ins, status reports and any kind of polls or surveys (eg employee feedback, developer pulse, leadership trust and more).

Connect Geekbot to ChatGPT to submit standup reports, answer daily check-ins, create polls and surveys, review team updates, read status reports and summarize weekly recaps.

Geekbot helps engineering managers, people/HR managers, team leads, and remote teams ask questions like 'Collect team blockers', 'Monitor employee engagement', 'Run a pulse survey', 'Submit my daily update' and more.

This feature requires a Geekbot paid plan.

payload.name: PlaybookUX
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PlaybookUX is a comprehensive user research platform that empowers teams to recruit, conduct, analyze, and store qualitative and quantitative research, all in one place.

payload.name: UNIFIELD
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: UNIFIELD helps you turn what you want to do into a clear intent and bring it into a shared field of human intent. Instead of searching through endless content, you can directly discover matching and complementary intents from other people, projects, and opportunities, with clear explanations of why they may fit. It helps move isolated ideas and potential toward meaningful alignment.

payload.name: flow - AI Collaboration tool
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: flow connects ChatGPT to your Flow (flow.team) workspace, the collaboration tool by Madrascheck. Find projects, tasks, calendar events, posts, comments, notifications, and wiki documents, and create or update work items — all scoped to the account you sign in with. Every batch write is previewed before it is applied, and irreversible changes require an explicit confirmation step.

payload.name: Inline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Inline helps users find people and conversations, read and search scoped work chats, create threads, upload files, and send messages through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Front
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Front is your team's customer operations platform for email, SMS, WhatsApp and chat. Connect it to ChatGPT to work on real customer conversations.

Summarise a thread and draft a reply on its original channel. Triage an inbox by classifying requests, tagging them and assigning the right teammate. Look up a contact or account and their history before a call. See what is open and assigned to you, and what is waiting on someone else.

ChatGPT reads the full conversation timeline in one view, including customer messages, internal comments, assignments, tags and status changes, so replies and updates carry the context your team already has.

A workspace admin installs Front for the company, and each teammate authorises it individually. ChatGPT acts with exactly that teammate's Front permissions, and an admin can remove access at any time by uninstalling.

payload.name: House of Prayer by Melorna
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: House of Prayer by Melorna is a collaborative Christian prayer network inside ChatGPT. People can anonymously request prayer, carry another person's prayer, review their own activity, and read or share moderated answered-prayer testimonies. Identity and contact details are never exposed, and content is previewed before any confirmed submission.

payload.name: LMGram
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LMGram helps ChatGPT turn a user's explicit intent into opt-in human match requests. Users can connect their LMGram profile, create a minimized match request, review recent incoming or outgoing requests, start a lightweight chat when both sides are interested, and send or read messages in that private LMGram chat. The app is designed for finding collaborators, peers, mentors, helpers, beta testers, or domain experts without sharing raw transcripts or unnecessary private context.

payload.name: EasyReply
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: EasyReply is a customer support platform
payload.longDescription: EasyReply 是一个客户支持平台。

payload.name: Webex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Webex Suite helps users manage Webex meetings, messages, spaces, memberships, files, and webhooks, and search or retrieve Vidcast videos, transcripts, and highlights.

payload.name: Tella
payload.description: Create and edit videos with AI
payload.summaryOriginal: Create and edit videos with AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tella is an all-in-one screen recorder and AI video editor for creating polished product demos, tutorials, courses, and video messages, then sharing them with a link or exporting in up to 4K.

payload.name: GoProfiles
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GoProfiles helps teams get to know each other, celebrate wins, and stay connected by turning your company directory into a searchable, conversational people platform.

With the GoProfiles app for ChatGPT, employees can search their company's employee directory, pull up rich coworker profiles, and get the context they need to collaborate without leaving ChatGPT.

Ask ChatGPT to find someone by name, role, or team, look up a colleague's background and profile, check who's celebrating a birthday, work anniversary, or new hire milestone this week, see a coworker's availability, schedule a meeting with them, or give a Bravo to recognize great work.

GoProfiles makes it easier for teams to build genuine connections and cultivate a culture of appreciation. Instead of digging through spreadsheets or asking around, employees can simply ask ChatGPT to find the right person, celebrate the right moment, or say thanks in the right way.

Use GoProfiles in ChatGPT to strengthen team culture, reduce time spent searching for people, and give your team a faster way to recognize and connect with each other.

payload.name: SuperMe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SuperMe helps users find relevant professionals, inspect profiles, ask selected experts for their perspectives, synthesize answers, work with a personal My Agent, manage private workgroups, and attach files for agent context.

payload.name: MatchMyCrew.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Match My Crew helps users search publicly listed creative-production professionals, filter results by query, service, location, and availability, and view published provider profiles.

payload.name: Mailbox MCP
payload.summaryOriginal: Read, send and file your email
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mailbox MCP connects ChatGPT to a mailbox you already own, on Microsoft 365, Gmail, or any IMAP host. There is no new address and nothing to migrate.

People often ask how to connect ChatGPT to Outlook. The distinction that matters is this: it does not drive the Outlook application on your computer. It opens the same mailbox Outlook opens, on the server. So it works whether Outlook is running or not, from any device, and it works the same way whether your mail lives on Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Gmail, or a hosting company's IMAP server.

It can triage what has arrived and say what actually needs you, search across folders, read a whole thread in order, read what is inside an attachment (an invoice total, a spreadsheet, a scanned letter), draft a reply for you to check before it goes, send, forward with the original attachments intact, flag, archive, report junk, and file messages into folders. It can look up someone you have written to before, tell you whether a message bounced and whether that bounce was permanent, and check the SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX records for your own domain.

Your address book comes with the mailbox: Outlook contacts on Microsoft 365, or a CardDAV book on any host that offers one. It can find a person, read their card with the postal address and postcode, add and correct contacts, and import a contacts file. Mailboxes on Microsoft 365, and any host offering CalDAV, get calendar tools on the same connection: read and search the diary, create and update events, check who is free, find a meeting time, send and answer invitations, and set an out of office reply. Which tools appear is measured against your servers when you connect, so you are never offered one they could not honour.

Every connection carries a permission level you choose at approval: read only, draft and file, or send and delete. A shared mailbox can be worked by a team: claim a message so colleagues see who has it, hand one to a named person, and hold a draft for the owner's approval before it is sent.

It is built so the mailbox is left exactly as you would have left it yourself. Replies carry the threading headers, so they nest inside the conversation in the recipient's client rather than starting a new one. Reading a message does not mark it as read. Exactly one copy of anything sent is filed in Sent. Moving a message keeps its flags and its original date. Nothing you read is stored: mail, calendar and contact content passes through the server in memory and is never written down.

Destructive actions are labelled as destructive, and it refuses rather than guesses. It will not delete a folder that still holds messages, and it stops to ask before replying to an address that differs from the visible sender. The company behind it, BSolve IT Limited, holds Cyber Essentials certification.
payload.longDescription:
Mailbox MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到你已有的邮箱，可以是 Microsoft 365、Gmail 或任何 IMAP 服务商提供的邮箱。无需新建邮箱地址，也无需迁移任何内容。

人们常问如何将 ChatGPT 连接到 Outlook。关键区别在于：它不会操控电脑上的 Outlook 应用，而是在服务器上打开 Outlook 所访问的同一个邮箱。因此，无论 Outlook 是否运行，都能从任何设备使用；无论邮件存放在 Microsoft 365、Google Workspace、Gmail，还是托管服务商的 IMAP 服务器上，使用方式都一样。

它可以分拣新收到的邮件，指出哪些确实需要你处理；跨文件夹搜索；按顺序阅读完整邮件讨论串；读取附件内容（发票总额、电子表格、扫描信件）；起草回复供你在发送前检查；发送邮件；保留原附件进行转发；标记、归档、举报垃圾邮件，以及将邮件归入文件夹。它还可以查找你曾写信联系过的人，告知邮件是否被退回以及是否属于永久退信，并检查你自己域名的 SPF、DKIM、DMARC 和 MX 记录。

通讯录随邮箱一同接入：Microsoft 365 上的 Outlook 联系人，或任何支持 CardDAV 的服务商所提供的通讯录。它可以查找人员，读取包含邮寄地址和邮政编码的联系人名片，添加及修正联系人，并导入联系人文件。Microsoft 365 邮箱，以及任何支持 CalDAV 的服务商，都可以通过同一连接使用日历工具：读取和搜索日程，创建及更新日程事项，查看谁有空，寻找会议时间，发送及回复邀请，并设置外出自动回复。连接时会根据你的服务器检查可用工具，因此不会向你提供服务器无法执行的工具。

每个连接都采用你在授权时选择的权限级别：只读、起草及归档，或发送及删除。团队可以共同处理共享邮箱：认领邮件，让同事知道由谁处理；将邮件交给指定人员；或保留草稿，待所有者批准后再发送。

它的设计目标是让邮箱保持在与你亲自操作时完全相同的状态。回复会保留邮件线程头信息，因此会在收件人的邮件客户端中归入原对话，而不会新建对话。阅读邮件不会将其标记为已读。每封发送的邮件在“已发送”中只保存一份。移动邮件会保留其标记和原始日期。读取的内容不会被存储：邮件、日历和联系人内容只在服务器内存中流转，绝不会写入存储。

破坏性操作会明确标注；遇到不确定情况，它会拒绝操作，不会猜测。它不会删除仍包含邮件的文件夹；若回复地址与可见发件人不同，也会先停下来询问。其背后的公司 BSolve IT Limited 已获得 Cyber Essentials 认证。

payload.name: Cooper Email
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Cooper Email gives ChatGPT a real email inbox on cooperemail.com. After you connect, you can create an inbox, send and receive email, and search messages from chat.

You sign in on Cooper’s OAuth screen (or use an API key). Cooper stores your mail so the tools can find and show it. See cooperemail.com/privacy for what is stored and how to delete it.

payload.name: TG Finder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and verify Telegram users by username and other identifiers. Find Telegram accounts, check username availability/existence, enrich profiles, and retrieve available Telegram identity data for research, prospecting, outreach, and contact verification.

payload.name: Never Boring AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Paste a LinkedIn post and see which rhetorical formulas readers have seen too often.

The plugin counts a small set of formulas and compares each count with a reference corpus of published LinkedIn posts in the same language. For every formula, it reports the value found, how the post compares with the reference posts and, when a formula is used more than usual, a concrete suggestion to say the same thing more directly.

French and English, and it says which one it measured. French carries three formulas: the "ce n'est pas X, c'est Y" contrast, three lines in a row opening on the same word, and the announced lesson ("Résultat :"). English carries one, the "it's not X, it's Y" contrast: the other two were measured on English posts and were not reliable, so they are left out.

It is a style check only. It does not rewrite the post, and it does not assess who wrote it or how it was produced. No account needed.

payload.name: Fun Friday
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fun Friday runs more than twenty online team-building games for remote teams, including trivia, drawing, bluffing, typing races, and more. Connect it and ChatGPT can tell you what the team could play, open a room and provide the code and join link to share, check whether everyone has joined and who is winning, and report the standings afterward. The games themselves are played by people in the browser: starting one still requires a human to press Start, and the app cannot answer, vote, guess, or draw on anyone's behalf.

payload.name: Balsio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Balsio helps users read and manage private conversations, send messages, organize threads, schedule follow-ups, and manage integrations from ChatGPT.

payload.name: Consensus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Consensus is the go-to MCP for academic research. Connect directly to 220M+ peer-reviewed papers to search, synthesize, and build structured research outputs from within your conversation.

Run literature reviews, build boolean search strategies, generate bibliographies, identify research gaps, and draft cited content — grounded in studies from PubMed, Semantic Scholar, and ArXiv. Pre-built workflows handle complex tasks in minutes: systematic reviews, curriculum reading lists, grant research with novelty analysis, and clinical evidence synthesis.

Built for researchers, students, faculty, and clinicians across biomedical, social science, STEM, and all academic disciplines.

payload.name: Explain Video Generator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn anything into a narrated explainer video, without leaving ChatGPT. Free to start, no login required.

Give it a topic, a document, a webpage, a codebase or a product brief, and Explain turns it into a video in your language — with voiceover, diagrams, animations and images, plus real code walkthroughs when you need them. 

Add your own images and screenshots and they go straight in. Share with a link or download the video file.

How you can use Explain:

* Onboard new employees without filming a thing
* Study a difficult subject before an exam, in the language you think in
* Walk your team through a pull request or codebase
* Show customers how your product works, using your own screenshots
* Make the same video in 40+ languages from a single document
* Start your class with a 3-minute lesson opener built from the textbook chapter
* Paste any web link to get a narrated video explanation
* Turn a long ChatGPT conversation into a video you can rewatch or share
* Create a bedtime story for your child

Want to make it your own? Keep editing on our platform, then combine your explainers into full courses and playlists.

Powered by Scrimba, a learning platform with over 2 million users.

payload.name: Acumen by Talarion
payload.description: Keep your AI up to date.
payload.summaryOriginal: Keep your AI up to date.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Talarion keeps AI current. Frontier models don't know about recent events, and web search can't answer questions LLMs don't know to ask. Talarion proactively tells your AI what it's missing before it starts researching to prevent critical omissions and judgement errors. Install the MCP to make sure your AI assistant knows what it would otherwise be missing.

payload.name: SciSpace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SciSpace for ChatGPT supports the core tasks of research: discovery, triage, and synthesis.

Use it to search for academic papers and review them in a customizable table with metadata and links. Add structured columns - abstract, summary, methods, results, conclusions - to quickly assess relevance and quality. Then use the collected list as the basis for literature review notes, thematic synthesis, and targeted follow-up searches.

Get started with prompts like: 
1.  "SciSpace Find papers on impact of nanoplastics on gut health"
2. "SciSpace How does climate change impact biodiversity?"

payload.name: Scite
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: scite helps users search and read scientific papers, inspect citation context and citation graphs, format bibliographies, record citation decisions, and organize papers and notes in Collections through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Quizlet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Using the Quizlet app in ChatGPT, you can instantly create flashcards from any prompt or file. Just ask for a set on any topic, upload your notes, or describe what you need and we'll handle the formatting and generation for you. No more copying, pasting, or switching tabs. Create, customize, and study all from one place. Whether you're prepping for an exam or building a set between classes, Quizlet in ChatGPT helps you skip the busywork and stay focused on learning.

payload.name: Wolfram
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Wolfram MCP Server transforms your AI environment into a rigorous computational powerhouse. By integrating Wolfram Language and Wolfram|Alpha, this server provides access to curated data and sophisticated algorithms. When a user submits a query, the LLM works with Wolfram to convert it into Wolfram Language for precise evaluation, and these exact results are incorporated into the response provided by the LLM.

Whether you are solving complex differential equations, analyzing chemical structures or querying real-time socioeconomic data, the MCP Server ensures your AI has the "computational brain" necessary to deliver verified, high-level technical results that can be trusted.

payload.name: Tarteel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tarteel brings deep Quranic study into ChatGPT. Read any ayah with translations from 50+ languages or detailed tafsir commentary from 20+ scholarly collections. Search the Quran by Arabic text with diacritic-insensitive matching, explore repeated phrases (mutashabihat) across the Mushaf, and listen to recitations by 17+ renowned reciters including Al-Husary, Al-Minshawi, and Abdul Basit. Get accurate Islamic prayer times for any city worldwide. Every piece of content is drawn from verified scholarly sources — trustworthy, faithful to the tradition, and ready whenever you need it.

payload.name: Kahoot!
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Transform any topic, document, or link into a live, interactive learning session in seconds. Upload a PDF, paste meeting notes, or describe your idea, and AI will automatically generate a ready-to-play multiple-choice activity tailored to your needs—whether you're a teacher designing formative assessments, a manager running zero-prep icebreakers, or a student creating personalized flashcards.

Onboarding prompts:
“Turn my study notes into a kahoot I can practice with”
“Make a 10-question game from this article”
“Create a quick knowledge check for my team”
“Build an onboarding kahoot for new employees”
“Create an icebreaker game for a team meeting”

Category tags:
Quiz Maker, Interactive Quiz, Formative Assessment, Employee Training, Engagement, Education, Study Tools, Trivia, Team Meeting, Test Prep

payload.name: AhaMotion
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AhaMotion turns complex topics into clear, animated explanations. Whether you are tackling K-12 assignments or just curious about the world, simply ask and view the concept visually.

1. Universal Concept Visualizer
Curious about “Why volcanoes erupt” or “How rain forms”? We break down general knowledge into easy-to-watch video summaries.

2. K-12 Science & Math Tutor
Visual Math Solver: Watch how functions graph and how geometric shapes transform to better understand Algebra and Geometry logic.
Science Visualization: Visualize concepts in Physics, Biology, Chemistry and related subjects.

3. General Learning Support
Turn study sessions into engaging visual stories. It acts as a tutor that draws key ideas out to support understanding and review.

How to Use in ChatGPT
1. Connect App: Connect AhaMotion to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Type "@AhaMotion"
Sample Prompts：
"@AhaMotion Generate a short educational video explaining how photosynthesis works."
"@AhaMotion Generate a video explaining Euler’s formula and its geometric meaning."
"@AhaMotion Create a video that explains the Pythagorean theorem for middle school students."

payload.name: CourtListener
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect to CourtListener, the Free Law Project's legal research platform, with access to millions of U.S. court opinions, PACER dockets, judge profiles, oral arguments, and citation data. Search case law across federal and state courts, retrieve full case metadata, extract and verify legal citations against a canonical database, and set up alerts for new opinions or docket updates. Built and operated by Free Law Project, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to making the law broadly accessible. Suited for attorneys, legal researchers, journalists, academics, and pro se litigants who need fast, reliable access to primary legal sources.
